title: Updates
tile.multi: Automatic updates don't run on an install that serves several gyms.
tile.off: Automatic patch updates are off. Turn them on in Settings → Updates.
tile.neverRun: No nightly update check has run yet. Installs set up with the installer check for patch releases each night.
tile.resumed: Automatic updates were off at the last nightly check. The next check runs tonight.
tile.stale: No nightly update check since {time}. On the server, check the timer with: systemctl status plaingym-update.timer
tile.upToDate: Version {version} is the newest patch release.
tile.rolledBack: Version {to} was rolled back and {from} is running again. {reason}
hold.byHand: To install it now, update by hand as the updating guide describes.
hold.wait: Do not install this release by hand: wait for a fixed release.
reason.check_failed: The app couldn't report its update setting.
reason.backups_not_configured: Backups aren't set up, so no backup could be taken first. Set them up in Settings → Email, payments and backups.
reason.no_signing_key: The server has no release signing key to check releases with. Install the current deployment files on the server.
reason.version_unknown: The running version couldn't be read from its image.
reason.release_list_unavailable: The list of releases couldn't be downloaded. The next nightly check tries again.
reason.manifest_unavailable: The release manifest couldn't be downloaded. The next nightly check tries again.
reason.manifest_invalid: The release manifest isn't valid, so it wasn't used.
reason.signature_invalid: The release manifest's signature didn't verify, so the release wasn't installed.
reason.pull_failed: The new version's image couldn't be downloaded. The next nightly check tries again.
reason.digest_mismatch: The downloaded image doesn't match the signed release manifest, so it wasn't installed.
reason.image_check_failed: The database changes of the new and running versions couldn't be compared, so nothing was installed.
reason.migration_in_patch: This patch release changes the database, which patch releases never do, so it wasn't installed automatically.
reason.snapshot_failed: The backup before the update failed. The next nightly check tries again.
reason.rolled_back_version: You rolled back from this version, so it does not install by itself. A newer patch release will. To install this one anyway, update by hand.
reason.health_check_failed: The new version failed its health check.
reason.interrupted: The update was interrupted, so the version recorded on the server was started again.
reason.rollback_failed: Starting the previous version failed too. On the server, check the containers with: sudo docker compose ps
section.description: Each night the server checks for a patch release of the version it runs (x.y.Z: fixes only, never database changes). If there is one, it takes a backup, installs it, checks that the app is healthy, and goes back to the previous version if not. The result shows on the Health page. Minor and major releases always wait for you.
section.label: Install patch releases automatically each night
section.loadFailed: Unable to load the update setting. Refresh to try again.
section.changed: Someone else changed this setting. It now shows their choice.
section.unavailable: Automatic patch updates don't run on an install that serves several gyms; its operator updates it.
